mentions.name: Git-like storage engine
mentions.description: A storage engine with Git-like properties, built by the same author as the underlying layer for a durable ECS system. Its durability is intended to let a machine be turned off at the mains mid-run and restarted while instantly carrying on as if nothing happened.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's to exercise a storage engine I have been building with Git like properties.
